detail.title: INTEX IT-1603 W SMPS & USB Computer Cabinet
detail.overview: The INTEX IT-1603 W Computer Cabinet combines durability, functionality, and a modern mesh-front design to deliver reliable performance for everyday computing needs. Constructed with a heavy-duty metallic steel body, this cabinet provides enhanced protection for internal components while ensuring optimal airflow through dedicated CPU and PCI graphic heat vents. With support for Micro ATX and Mini ATX motherboards, multiple USB ports, front-panel audio and microphone connectivity, and ATX PSU compatibility, the IT-1603 W is an excellent choice for home, office, educational, and business desktop systems.
